data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded an adverse prior-year reserve development of $92.0m in 2018, reflecting deterioration on prior accident years. The movement was primarily driven by London Wholesale Property ($96.0m) and International discontinued casualty ($17.0m), partially offset by a favourable movement on Marine ($20.0m). The year was also affected by a group of second-half 2018 catastrophe events (California wildfires, Typhoon Jebi, Typhoon Trami, Hurricanes Michael and Florence) which produced collective gross losses of $453m and net losses of $218m after reinsurance. Additionally, an RITC from S1209 materially increased gross claims outstanding during the year.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure ($92m) taken from Note 5 narrative 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding'. Note gives explicit $92m but does not tabulate a 'gross' column; assumed gross as part of the 'movement in prior year's provision' note. The technical provisions include a large RITC from S1209 ($532.922m) which materially affects comparatives and can distort development analysis. All amounts in the statements are presented in $000s and converted to millions for this JSON.
